description: Represents a notification subscriber linking providers with consumers.

id.description: Unique identifier for the subscriber entry.

providerName.description: Name of the data provider publishing notifications.

consumerName.description: Name of the consumer receiving notifications.

eventTriggers.description: List of event triggers that should notify this consumer.

active.description: Flag indicating if the subscriber is currently active.

dateCreated.description: The date/time of when the vertex was created.

providerIdentity.description: Identity (e.g. DID) of the data provider.

providerConfig.description: Configuration payload required for outbound notifications.

consumerConfig.description: Configuration payload required for outbound notifications.

dateModified.description: The date/time of when the resource was last modified.
